description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for git reflog display routines. It includes setup commands, test definitions, and expected output checks to verify various formats and behaviors of the 'git reflog' command.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, executing command sequences and checking for success conditions.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timer to mimic passage of time between tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output against expected output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty, asserting no unexpected data is present.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or checks configuration variables for testing environment.
